'''Feral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]]. He was the son of [[Kycina]] and the brother of both [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. He was among those chosen by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to compete for the honor of being her chosen champion to aid in her campaign of vengeance against her former master, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Feral was born the son<ref name="REST" /> of the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kycina]]<ref name="REST" /> on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Clone Card: Feral" /> As a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] male, he was a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]]<ref name="Monster" /> and had two older brothers,<ref name="REST" /> [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="Monster" />

===The Tests===
Until [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Feral lived as one of the tribal leaders in his [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] community, living closely and in admiration to his older brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]]. He, his brother Savage, their father figure [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]] and several other male Zabraks lived untouched by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] until [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], under influence of Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] came and selected several of them to compete for her.<ref name="Monster" />

Feral, along with his brother, was nominated to be taken to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] to be transformed into a true warrior. He and only a few other of his kin were selected to enter the trials.<ref name="Monster" />

===Death===
[[File:SavageStranglesFeral-Monster.png|thumb|left|200px|Feral's death at the hands of his brother]]
With his [[Savage Opress/Legends|brother's]] help, Feral survived the [[Selection/Legends|tests]], but at Savage's request, was spared after failing in the final challenge. Shortly after Savage was taken by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], Feral was taken prisoner by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], and brought before his brother, who had been transformed by the [[Dathomir Magic|Nightsister's magic]]. Although Feral tried desperately to appeal to Savage's love for him, the mutated [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother's]] mind had been twisted by the Nightsister's spells, and, disgusted by Feral's weakness, paid no heed. Finally, at Ventress' command and with only a moment's hesitation, Savage snatched Feral up and used his newfound strength to break Feral's neck, [[Death/Legends|murdering]] his brother<ref name="Monster" /> in a monstrous display of cruelty<ref name="Clone Card: Feral" /> and passing his final test.<ref name="Monster" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feral first appeared in the episode "[[Monster]]" in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', where he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Monster" /> In the script of the episode Feral, [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]] were the only [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] to be named.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref>
